main_measure.name: slope of 20-bar excess log return on forecast (non-overlapping blocks)

statistic.name: OLS slope t, SE clustered by coin (CR1)

main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with coin-clustered t >= 2; reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 100 blocks with forecast < 0

supporting_check.name: share of negative excess blocks when forecast < 0 minus share across all blocks

decided_by: The slope is negative with coin-clustered t <= -2: deeper shorts are followed by rebounds.
reading: Blocks start at rows 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with the full 20-bar forward log return inside the window; the coin-window mean 20-bar return is the mean of those block returns; the regression is pooled OLS with intercept and Stata-style CR1 coin-clustered standard errors; the supporting check passes if the short-block share of negative excess returns exceeds the all-block share.
